meta.title: AWS CostPilot
meta.description: Estimate your service's monthly AWS bill in seconds

hero.body: Assemble resources yourself or just describe your service — get a monthly estimate in both USD and KRW instantly. Not sure what to build? AI recommends an architecture and ways to cut costs.
hero.snapshotBasis: USD + KRW · based on your configuration

optimization.title: The calculation is where it starts, not ends.
optimization.body: Get practical savings suggestions like switching to Graviton or downsizing RDS/Redis, plus a plain-language explanation of why your bill looks the way it does.
optimization.optimizationExample: “Switching ECS to Graviton (ARM) could save about 20% per month”
optimization.explanationExample: “RDS dominates your bill because of the instance tier, not storage”

items.title: Solo side-project builders
items.body: For developers who want to know their monthly bill before they ever deploy.
points: Assemble resources yourself and see the cost instantly
Calculate right away — no signup required
Save the result as a card image or PDF to share

items.title: Teams whose traffic just started growing
items.body: For engineers sketching out the next-stage architecture and hunting for wasted spend.
points: Describe your service and let AI recommend an architecture
Get concrete savings ideas like Graviton or downsizing
Save calculation history and compare over time

items.title: PMs and finance folks, not engineers
items.body: For people who don't know the AWS console but still need to know what this quote costs.
points: Understand why a cost came out this way, in plain language
See the number in KRW directly — no manual conversion
Export to PDF and attach it straight to a report

finalCta.title: See it for yourself, right now.
finalCta.body: You can calculate without creating an account.

footer.tagline: Estimates your monthly AWS bill from your service details and system diagram.

modeShowcase.title: However you get there, the result is the same report.

wizard.body: Fill in basics like monthly users and request volume, then pick and configure resources like ECS or RDS one by one — the per-resource price and total are computed instantly.

dragBuilder.body: Place real AWS resources like ECS, RDS, Redis, and ALB onto the canvas — per-resource pricing and the total are computed accurately on the spot.

aiRecommend.body: Describe how many users and what kind of service in a sentence or two, and AI puts together an architecture that fits your traffic and stage.
aiRecommend.descriptionExample: “A commerce API server for about 50k monthly users”
aiRecommend.recommendationDetail: 2× ECS + RDS + Redis cache + ALB + CloudFront
